text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Thursday.
- Session of the National Defence and Security Council (VONS): Elections in the Croatian Danube region to be held on December 15.
- 25 to 30 bodies recovered from the Ovcara mass grave.
- Croatian and Bavarian governments sign agreement on the construction of the Croatian section of the Pyhrn road.
- World Bank to inject $1,5 million in an environment protection project aimed at dealing with waste threatening the Adriatic.
- Decision on the return of Bosnian refugees to be made in Bonn today: Forced repatriation "possible and acceptable" according to some German ministers.
- Armed robbers steal 300,000 German marks from a central payments bureau branch in a sleepy town 40 kilometers south-east of Zagreb.
- Foreign minister Mate Granic's foreign policy report: There are no disputes over the Prevlaka pensinsula. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
